description: This is a React component for displaying and managing a list of devices, including loading data from an API, deletion, and pinging devices. It integrates with other components like DeviceTable and ConfirmDialog, and uses React hooks for state management and side effects.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches the list of devices from the backend API and updates component state accordingly.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Sets the device ID to be deleted, triggering confirmation dialog.

methods.name: confirmDelete
methods.description: Deletes the device after user confirmation and updates the device list.

methods.name: handlePing
methods.description: Pings a device to check its status, updates device data, and displays result via toast.
